answer: An admission auction sells 100 slots per epoch, so identities cannot be minted free. Each applicant forges one bid backed by a deposit; bids from one operator merge into the highest. Winners join a sable register open to audit, deposits locked 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes means winning 1,000 slots at 50 units each, 50,000 locked, while an honest agent pays 50 once, delivers verified timber, recovers its deposit, and keeps undiluted rewards.
